description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of 11 distinct task categories within the MMRA benchmark, each represented by a uniquely colored slice and labeled with its corresponding name, count, and percentage. The largest segment is 'ObservationAngle,' accounting for 126 samples (12.28%), followed by 'SimilarMaterial' with 106 samples (10.33%) and 'SubEvent' with 100 samples (9.74%). Other notable categories include 'UsageSimilarity' (100 samples, 9.65%), 'NearSameEntity' (63 samples, 6.34%), 'RelativePosition' (81 samples, 7.90%), 'MentalitySimilarity' (89 samples, 8.67%), 'SimilarEvent' (90 samples, 8.77%), 'AppearanceSimilarity' (90 samples, 8.77%), 'Environment' (90 samples, 8.77%), and 'Layout' (90 samples, 8.77%). The chart visually emphasizes that 'Environment,' 'Layout,' 'SimilarEvent,' and 'AppearanceSimilarity' each constitute the same proportion of the dataset, while 'NearSameEntity' is the smallest category. All percentage values are clearly labeled within their respective slices, and the color-coding effectively distinguishes each category for clarity.
